g.text: How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a megrim.
How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a migraine.
Ah. Yes. I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.

I see, that must be this era's word for my severe headaches. Yes, I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.
She only said you weren't well out of concern for you.
It just came up in passing. She didn't tell me to check on you.
I am doing well, thank you kindly for asking. How are you?
It will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.
Of course. Marie would cure the world with all the rays of Sol if she could. But it will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.
I'm all right. I was just checking in, I heard you weren't doing well yesterday.
I'm fighting a bit of a megrim, personally.
I'm fighting a bit of a migraine, personally.
I'm fighting a bit of a headache, personally.
I just know from personal experience that sometimes the moments we don't want to accept help from others are the precise moments we need that help the most.
I respect that. I won't pry if you don't want to talk. But I am here to listen if you do.
She seemed to imply that you had theories as to why you get these headaches?
Marie thinks you're trying to carry the burden of all of this alone. I wanted you to know I'm here.
Marie believes you are needlessly suffering through this whole situation. I was wondering if I could help.
Ah. I see. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.
I imagine that is this era's word for the severe headaches I suffer from as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
I'm not saying this moment is that time. But if that time comes? I'm here.
And such theories are, unfortunately, now cast quite firmly into "the Void."
You will have to pardon me, Drifter, when I say this:
Hm. I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.
You're right. I'll go. I just wanted to see how you were, first.
You caught me. I'm just not sure how else to... connect with you.
I'll be all right for a little longer. How long have you suffered from these kinds of headaches?
What is that supposed to mean?
I am surrounded now by strangers and talking beasts in a world of fantastical madness and seemingly endless and rampant slaughter.
I appreciate your willingness to admit to a lie so readily. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.
It is a personal matter, Drifter. I appreciate your attempt at conversing with me. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.
All that I have known has been swept away by glowing beams of "Jade Light" and "the Orokin Empire" and "the Void" and is threatened by "the Murmur."
As you can "see," I am quite recovered. And now you must worry about yourself. Now go find a dark place to recover.
May I be blunt and ask as to why you are attempting to socialize with me at all?
So, you will have to excuse me if I find this... offer of kinship from you oddly laughable in its naïveté. I neither know you nor trust you. Indeed, all I have to go on is the word of others.
Begone, Drifter. Before I find you and force you to rest. And none of us will enjoy that.
If we're being blunt, I honestly cannot stop thinking about you ever since we met.
Entrati เปลี่ยนเจ้าให้กลายเป็น Protoframe และตอนนี้เจ้าอยู่ที่นี่ ไม่ต้องเตรียมตัวอะไรเลย ถ้าข้าช่วยเจ้าปรับตัวได้ ก็อยากช่วยนะ
Well...? I think you're fascinating. I want to get you know you better.
The word of others whom I also neither know nor trust as of yet. All of this is heaped upon us, never mind the burdens you cannot see.
Well... I might enjoy that more than you think.

So, I appreciate your affability and apologize for the lack of mine own. I know what you are attempting, and I commend you for it. And I hope, that should the time come that I am in need of your aid, the offer still stands.
In the words of a dear friend, "i'm stubborn, m8."
Chat ends. Next chat will be LyonFlirt.
Chat ends. Next chat will be LyonFlirt.
